subject: general
question:
Select the meaning of the given idiom.

lose your marbles
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"lose your marbles"** means to go insane or to lose one's mind. (पागल हो जाना)

 
 
• **Example: **After working for 20 hours straight, he felt like he was about to ***lose his marbles.***
 
 
 
• **"Go insane"** refers to losing mental stability or becoming mentally ill. (पागल हो जाना)
 
 
• **Example: **The constant stress at work almost made him ***go insane.***
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **go insane**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lose respect** (सम्मान खोना): To no longer be admired or regarded highly by others.

 
 
• **Example: **He began to*** lose respect*** among his peers after the scandal.
 
 
 
• **Miss an opportunity** (मौका चूकना): To fail to take advantage of a chance.
 
 
• **Example: **She ***missed an opportunity*** to advance her career by not applying for the job.
 
 
 
• **Be nervous** (घबराना): To feel anxious or uneasy.
 
 
• **Example: **He ***was nervous*** before his big presentation.
